info.name: Heritage VQA - Complete API
info.description: 33 API operations + SSE replay/intermediate/Markdown variants. Import an environment, run folders 01-09 in order. Tokens/asset_id/run_id are saved automatically. Optional upload requires choosing a file and enable_upload=true. Folder 10 requires run_lifecycle_actions=true and revokes the session last. Review creates a child run and calls only Judge. See docs/postman.md. No real credentials are included.

request.description:
POST /api/v1/runs/{run_id}/review

Create a child run that reuses stored evidence/draft and executes only Judge. Original run is preserved.

exec: if (!pm.variables.get('access_token')) throw new Error('Run Create session first.');
if (!pm.variables.get('run_id')) throw new Error('Missing run_id; run the earlier setup requests.');
